name: Fan Speed -> LED Color
Denise sleep status -> Office LED indicators
info:
Drives two always-on LED indicators from the bedroom/bathroom lights so Gary can tell from the office whether Denise is asleep:

- GREEN: bedroom light or reading lamp on (awake)
- ORANGE (yellow on the ZEN32 - it has no orange): bedroom lights off but bathroom-area lights on (winding down)
- RED: all of the above off (asleep)

Targets: Office_Sink Jasco switch LED (params 3/34) and Office_Scene_Switch ZEN32 button 3 / lower-left LED (params 4/9), both via Z2M configuration /set topics. The mode param is re-asserted to Always On (3) on every tier change.

name: Game light forced-off guard
info: The Game switch (Z-Wave node 18) historically fell out of sync (physically on, HA=off) because its lifeline association was missing - fixed by re-interview 2026-07-18. This guard adds belt-and-braces: whenever ANY light.turn_off targets the Game light (Denise's remote, goodnight, dashboard, voice), wait 5 s, then publish a direct Z-Wave Binary Switch Set false via the Z2M value-write topic. It bypasses every state cache, an equal-value Set is harmless, and zwave-js's own verification Get re-syncs HA afterwards.
